env._comment: A dev client runs on a device sharing your wifi, so a LAN address is correct here. It must be YOUR machine's current IP — 192.168.x.x changes between networks. Cleartext HTTP is allowed in a dev build; a release build is not, so use https for any other profile.

An installable APK for testers. It must reach the deployed server, not a developer's laptop — a LAN address here is why the previous preview APK failed every request off the author's wifi. app.config.js rejects a private address for this profile.

Previously unset, which made the app fall back to http://10.0.2.2:3000 — the Android emulator's alias for the host — so a store build could never reach a server. app.config.js now fails the build if this is missing or private.
